sql.value: select t.task_time as taskTime, t.task_type as taskType, t.task_id as taskId, t.task_creater_name as taskCreaterName, t.task_all_count as taskAllCount, t.task_success_count taskSuccessCount, t.task_fail_count as taskFailCount, t.task_all_count - t.task_success_count -t.task_fail_count as taskUnCounts from financial.fxy_financial_all_task t where 1=1 #[t.task_time = :taskTime] #[and t.task_creater_name = :taskCreaterName] order by task_time desc

select task_item_id as taskItemId, company_name as companyName, task_item_log as taskItemLog, t.task_item_status as taskItemstatus, task_params as taskParams from fxy_financial_task_item t where 1=1 #[t.task_id = :taskId] #[and t.task_item_status = :taskItemstatus] order by task_item_status desc

INSERT INTO financial.fxy_financial_all_task (task_id, task_time, task_type, task_all_count, task_success_count, task_fail_count, task_creater_name) VALUES( :taskId, :taskTime, :taskType, :taskAllCount, :taskSuccessCount, :taskFailCount, :taskCreaterName)

INSERT INTO financial.fxy_financial_task_item ( task_item_id, task_id, account_sets_id, company_name, task_item_log, task_item_status, task_params, invoice_start_date, invoice_end_date, invoice_type ) VALUES( :taskItemId, :taskId, :accountSetId, :companyName, :taskItemLog, :taskItemStatus, :taskParams, :invoiceStartDate, :invoiceEndDate, :invoiceType )
update financial.fxy_financial_all_task set task_success_count = :taskSuccessCount, task_fail_count = :taskFailCount where task_id = :taskId
update financial.fxy_financial_all_task set task_success_count = :taskSuccessCount + task_success_count, task_fail_count = task_fail_count - :task_success_count where task_id = :taskId
update financial.fxy_financial_task_item set task_item_log = :taskItemLog, task_item_status = :taskItemStatus where task_item_id = :taskItemId

SELECT invoice_type AS invoiceType ,MAX(b.task_time) AS taskTime FROM `fxy_financial_task_item` a LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_all_task b ON a.task_id=b.task_id WHERE :searchDate >= invoice_start_date AND :searchDate <= invoice_end_date AND account_sets_id = :accountSetsId AND task_item_status = '1' GROUP BY invoice_type
